dice: 2d6 — 2-5: You can't keep up. Drink 3. 6-12: N spins away on a Ferris wheel. Give 3.

title: Ghetsis
rules: Ghetsis, in a cape with eyes on it, calls you worthless trash. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Worthless. Drink 10 and call yourself trash. 2-7: Worthless. Drink 5 and call yourself trash. 8-19: His cape rips. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! His cape rips. Give 8.

title: Flare Grunt
rules: A Flare Grunt in a red suit says your outfit is ugly. Defend your outfit and roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It's ugly. Drink 6, and the table rates your outfit out of 10. 2-6: It's ugly. Drink 3, and the table rates your outfit out of 10. 7-19: Fashion wins. The table points at the worst-dressed player; they drink 3. 20-20: Natural 20! Fashion wins. The table points at the worst-dressed player; they drink 6.

title: Flare Scientist
rules: A Flare scientist in orange goggles shows you a doomsday weapon. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: It works. Drink 3. 2-2: It's a laser pointer, aimed at your eye. Drink 3. 3-3: It's a toaster. Give 3. 4-4: It's a hair straightener. Give 3. 5-5: It explodes in his hand. Give 3. 6-6: It's a disco ball. Everyone dances; the stiffest drinks 3.

title: Flare Admin
rules: A Flare admin charges five million to join. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You paid. Drink 6 and compliment everyone's outfit. 2-6: You paid. Drink 3 and compliment everyone's outfit. 7-19: You talk her down. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You talk her down. Give 6.

title: Lysandre
rules: Lysandre's hair is on fire, figuratively. He wants a beautiful world. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-6: Beautiful. Drink 5. 7-12: The ultimate weapon misfires. Give 4.

title: Skull Grunt

dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! YO. Do the Skull pose, then drink 6. 2-6: YO. Do the Skull pose, then drink 3. 7-19: No YO. The table picks the worst pose; that player drinks 2. 20-20: Natural 20! No YO. The table picks the worst pose; that player drinks 4.

title: Rapping Grunt
rules: A Skull Grunt raps at you badly. Rap back four lines, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! His bars were better. Drink 6. 2-6: His bars were better. Drink 3. 7-19: No bars. Give 3, in rhyme. 20-20: Natural 20! No bars. Give 6, in rhyme.

rules: Big sis Plumeria wants to know why you hurt her boys. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: She hurts you. Drink 3. 2-2: She calls your mom. Drink 3 and apologize. 3-3: She respects you. Give 3. 4-4: She lets her boys go home. Give 3. 5-5: She buys you a drink. Give 4. 6-6: She joins your side. Give 4.

rules: Guzma is the hated boss who beats you down. He says so himself. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Beaten down. Drink 10, and shout "Guzma!" like he does. 2-7: Beaten down. Drink 5, and shout "Guzma!" like he does. 8-19: Guzma, what is you doing? Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! Guzma, what is you doing? Give 8.

rules: Oleana, Chairman Rose's secretary, has a meeting with you. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! The meeting ran long. Drink 6 and summarize it for the table. 2-6: The meeting ran long. Drink 3 and summarize it for the table. 7-19: Meeting cancelled. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! Meeting cancelled. Give 6.

title: Macro Intern
rules: An intern asks you to fill out a feedback survey before battling. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Twenty questions. Drink 3. 2-2: Mandatory feedback. Drink 2 and name one thing the table could do better. 3-3: You lie on the survey. Give 3. 4-4: You give it five stars. Give 3. 5-5: You fill it out for him. Give 3. 6-6: He quits. Give 4.

rules: Tower Security wants your badge. Not that badge, your ID badge. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You don't have one. Drink 6 and say your full name. 2-6: You don't have one. Drink 3 and say your full name. 7-19: You walk right past. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You walk right past. Give 6.

rules: A kettle and a sign: WASH YOUR OWN MUG. Everyone mimes washing one.

title: The Fire Escape
rules: Stars, a city, and the street far below. Everyone toasts how far you've come.

title: The Service Stairs
rules: Halfway down, a step wide enough to sit on. Everyone says what they'd order right now.

title: The Bunker
rules: An old bomb shelter with canned beans. Everyone names who they'd want down here.

title: The Laundry Room
rules: Warm dryers humming. Everyone confesses their worst laundry crime.

title: The Stuck Elevator
rules: An elevator stuck between floors, the music still playing. Everyone hums along on three.

title: Gelatinous Shot
rules: A wobbling cube of jello shots. Something's floating in it. A tooth? Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It engulfs you. Drink 6, no hands. 2-6: It engulfs you. Drink 3, no hands. 7-19: You eat your way out. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You eat the whole thing. Give 6.

title: Rats in a Coat
rules: Nine rats in a trench coat are trying to order a drink. Card them. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Their ID is better than yours. Drink 6. 2-6: Their ID is better than yours. Drink 3. 7-19: Bounced. Give 3 to whoever looks most like a rat in a coat. 20-20: Natural 20! Bounced. Give 6 to whoever looks most like a rat in a coat.

title: Mold Elemental
rules: The thing growing behind the ice machine has feelings and a mouth. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It moves into your lungs. Drink 6 and cough on both neighbors. 2-6: You breathe it in. Drink 3 and cough on your left neighbor. 7-19: Bleach. So much bleach. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! Bleach. So much bleach. Give 6.

title: Drunk Goblin
rules: A goblin who's had nine. He wants to fight you, then hug you. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He wins both. Drink 6 and hug your right neighbor. 2-6: He wins both. Drink 3 and hug your right neighbor. 7-19: He passes out on you. Loot his pockets. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! He passes out on you. Loot his pockets. Give 4.

title: Skeleton Barback
rules: He's been restocking limes since 1974. Ask for a fresh one and roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He throws one at your eye. Drink 6. 2-6: He throws one at your eye. Drink 3. 7-19: He finds one. It's perfect. Give 3, with a lime if there is one. 20-20: Natural 20! He finds one. It's perfect. Give 6, with a lime if there is one.

title: Possessed Mop
rules: The mop is moving on its own and it's coming for your shoes. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: It mops your face. Drink 3. 2-2: It mops your drink. Drink 3. 3-3: You trip it. Give 2. 4-4: You snap the handle. Give 3. 5-5: You wring it out over the sink. Give 3. 6-6: You ride it like a witch's broom. Everyone else drinks 1.

title: Keg Spider
rules: Eight legs, eight beers, zero manners. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Bitten. Drink 6, and do a spider walk to the fridge and back. 2-6: Bitten. Drink 3, and do a spider walk to the fridge and back. 7-19: Squished. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! Squished, and its web was full of coasters. Give 6.

title: Tab Goblin
rules: It's been putting drinks on your tab since 2019. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It collects. Drink 8. 2-6: It collects. Drink 4. 7-19: You stiff it. Give 3 to whoever owes you money. 20-20: Natural 20! You stiff it. Give 6 to whoever owes you money.

title: Goblin Shaman
rules: A goblin in a bucket hat waves a burnt sage stick at you and chants. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! The chant works. Drink 6. 2-6: The chant works. Drink 3. 7-19: You blow out the sage. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You blow out the sage. Give 6.

title: Cask Bat
rules: A bat lives in the empty cask and it hates the lights. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-5: It gets tangled in your hair. Drink 3. 6-12: You shoo it into a bucket. Give 3.

title: Clipboard Troll
rules: You're not on the list. Walk heel to toe across the room and back. Wobble: drink 3.

title: The Riddling Tap
rules: A tap with a face. Your left neighbor asks a riddle: 10 seconds, or drink 3.

title: The Stuck Door
rules: Brace it shut with your back: wall-sit for 30 seconds. Stand early: drink 3.

title: Keg Stand-Off
rules: Staring contest with your right neighbor. You blink or laugh first: drink 3.

title: Sticky Floor
rules: Your shoes are glued to forty years of spilled lager. Roll d20 to pull free.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You leave a shoe behind. Drink 4, and stay one shoe down until your next turn. 2-8: You leave a shoe behind. Drink 2, and stay one shoe down until your next turn. 9-19: You peel free. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You peel free. Give 4.

title: Tripwire
rules: Someone strung Christmas lights across the stairs at shin height. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You eat the stairs. Drink 4. 2-8: You eat the stairs. Drink 2. 9-19: You hop it. Give 2 to the clumsiest player here. 20-20: Natural 20! You hop it. Give 4 to the clumsiest player here.

title: Rolling Kegs
rules: The keg rack groans. Then it lets go. Roll d20 to dive.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Flattened. Drink 6. 2-8: Flattened. Drink 3. 9-19: You dive clear. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You dive clear. Give 4.

title: Loose Tap Handles
rules: A rack of novelty tap handles is right above your head. It's swaying. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! A plastic shark to the skull. Drink 4. 2-8: A plastic shark to the skull. Drink 2. 9-19: You catch the shark. Keep it. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You catch the shark. Keep it. Give 4.

title: Lost Bridesmaids
rules: Two lost bridesmaids have decided you're the groom. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! First dance. Drink 4, then sway with your right neighbor. 2-6: First dance. Drink 2, then sway with your right neighbor. 7-19: You point them upstairs. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You point them upstairs. Give 4.

title: The Rat Pack
rules: Three rats in fedoras, singing Sinatra, and they want your stool. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! They do it their way. Drink 4. 2-6: They do it their way. Drink 2. 7-19: You heckle them offstage. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You heckle them offstage. Give 4.

title: Fryer Oil Ooze
rules: Twenty years of fryer oil got up and walked. It smells like Tuesday. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It hugs you. Drink 6, then wipe your hands on your jeans. 2-6: It hugs you. Drink 3, then wipe your hands on your jeans. 7-19: You salt it and it shrivels. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You salt it and it shrivels. Give 6.

title: Barback Poltergeist
rules: An invisible barback keeps stacking empty glasses on your head. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! The tower falls. Drink 6. 2-6: The tower falls. Drink 3. 7-19: You tip him a coin and he floats off. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You tip him a coin and he floats off. Give 6.

title: Cobweb Bartender
rules: A bartender made of cobwebs slides you something cloudy. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: You drink it. Drink 3. 2-2: He pours you a second. Drink 3. 3-3: You send it back. Give 2. 4-4: You tip him a moth. Give 3. 5-5: You order a round for the table. Everyone else drinks 1. 6-6: You pour him one for once. Give 3.

title: The Low Beam
rules: Your right neighbor holds out an arm as the beam. Limbo under it. Touch it: drink 3.

title: Loose Floorboard
rules: One board in the cellar floor is not like the others. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It springs up and smacks you. Drink 4. 2-8: It springs up and smacks you. Drink 2. 9-19: You step over it like a cat. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You step over it like a cat. Give 4.

title: The Stag Party
rules: Eight men in matching shirts, one in a veil, all looking for a ninth. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Recruited. Drink 4, then give a best-man toast. 2-6: Recruited. Drink 2, then give a best-man toast. 7-19: You send them to the Wine Cellar. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You send them to the Wine Cellar. Give 4.

title: Grease Trap Horror
rules: The grease trap has been fed fries for twenty years. Now it's hungry. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It slurps you in. Drink 8, then wash your hands in shame. 2-9: It slurps you in. Drink 4, then wash your hands in shame. 10-19: You seal the lid and sit on it. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You seal the lid and sit on it. Give 8.

title: The Health Inspector
rules: Clipboard, hairnet, no soul. He's here to shut the cellar down. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Violation. Drink 8 and name three things wrong with this room. 2-9: Violation. Drink 4 and name three things wrong with this room. 10-19: You bribe him with a keg. He leaves his lucky pen. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You bribe him with a keg. He leaves his lucky pen. Give 8.

title: Keg Mimic Queen
rules: Every keg in the rack opens one eye. The big one in the middle opens two. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! The whole rack bites. Drink 8. 2-9: The whole rack bites. Drink 4. 10-19: You tap the queen. The rack goes quiet. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You tap the queen. The rack goes quiet. Give 8.

title: The Exterminator
rules: He's here for the rats, and he's decided you count. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Sprayed. Drink 8, holding your breath. 2-9: Sprayed. Drink 4, holding your breath. 10-19: You hide him in an empty keg. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You hide him in an empty keg. Give 8.

title: Keg Golem
rules: It's 800 pounds of lager and it's been tapped. Everyone drinks 1, then you roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It sits on you. Drink 8. 2-8: It sits on you. Drink 4. 9-19: You pull its plug. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You drink it dry. Everyone else drinks 3.

title: The Rat King
rules: Forty rats in one crown, holding court by the drain. Kiss the ring, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! The court finds you delicious. Finish your drink. 2-8: The court finds you guilty. Drink 4. 9-19: You dethrone him. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You dethrone him. Give 10.

title: The Landlord
rules: He wants three months' rent and he's taking it out of your drink. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Evicted. Finish your drink. 2-8: Late fee. Drink 4. 9-19: You find a code violation. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You find a code violation. Give 10.

title: Big Cheese
rules: A rat the size of a fridge, wearing a cheese wheel as armor. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It sits on your snacks. Drink 8. 2-8: It sits on your snacks. Drink 4. 9-19: You eat through the armor. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You eat the armor and the rat. Everyone else drinks 3.

title: The Pipe Organ
rules: Every pipe in the cellar is playing one chord, and it's coming from a face. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You join the chord. Hum for 10 seconds, then drink 8. 2-8: The chord hits you in the teeth. Drink 4. 9-19: You find the off switch. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You find the off switch. Give 10.

title: Boxed Wine Golem
rules: A golem made of boxed wine, slapping its own bag. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It slaps you with the bag. Drink 6, and slap the table twice. 2-6: It slaps you with the bag. Drink 3, and slap the table twice. 7-19: You pop the spout. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You drink the bag dry. Give 6.

title: Cork Imp
rules: A tiny imp popping corks at eye level and laughing about it. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Right in the eye. Drink 3 with one eye shut. 2-2: Right in the drink. Drink 3. 3-3: You duck. Give 2. 4-4: You cork him. Give 3. 5-5: You cork him and shake him. Give 3. 6-6: You pop one back at him. Everyone else drinks 1.

title: Zombie Sommelier
rules: Brains? No. He wants to describe the finish. It takes eleven minutes. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Notes of oak. Drink 6 and describe the finish of yours. 2-6: Notes of oak. Drink 3 and describe the finish of yours. 7-19: You spit in his bucket. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You spit in his bucket. Give 6.

title: Wine Mom Banshee
rules: She screams that it's five o'clock somewhere, and she means here. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! She tells you about her divorce. All of it. Drink 6. 2-6: It's five o'clock. Drink 3. 7-19: You take her glass away. Give 3 to the biggest wine mom here. 20-20: Natural 20! You take her glass away. Give 6 to the biggest wine mom here.

title: Rosé Slime
rules: Pink, sticky, and it says it's not like other slimes. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It's exactly like other slimes. Drink 6. 2-6: It's exactly like other slimes. Drink 3. 7-19: You pop it. It leaves pink smoke behind. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You pop it. It leaves pink smoke behind. Give 4.

title: Ghost in the Decanter
rules: It's been breathing for a hundred years. So has the wine. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It breathes on you. Drink 6. 2-6: It breathes on you. Drink 3. 7-19: You jam the stopper in. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You jam the stopper in. Give 6.

title: Barrel Mimic
rules: Barrel 14 has teeth. Barrel 15 looks nervous. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Barrel 14 wins. Drink 8. 2-6: Barrel 14 wins. Drink 4. 7-19: You tap it. It whimpers. Give 3 to the most nervous-looking person. 20-20: Natural 20! You tap it. It whimpers. Give 6 to the most nervous-looking person.

title: Corkscrew Crab
rules: A crab with corkscrews for claws, opening anything. Including you. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Uncorked. Drink 6 and walk sideways to your seat. 2-6: Uncorked. Drink 3 and walk sideways to your seat. 7-19: You flip it on its back. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You open a bottle with it. Give 6.

title: Sangria Sprite
rules: A sprite made of fruit chunks and bad decisions throws an orange slice at you. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Fruit to the face. Drink 6. 2-6: Fruit to the face. Drink 3. 7-19: You eat the sprite. It was mostly brandy. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You eat the sprite. It was mostly brandy. Give 6.

title: Vinegar Vampire
rules: A vampire who only drinks from bottles that turned. He's been at yours. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He's right, it turned. Drink 6, make the face. 2-6: He's right, it turned. Drink 3, make the face. 7-19: You hold up a cross made of corkscrews. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You hold up a cross made of corkscrews. Give 6.

title: Blind Tasting
rules: Eyes shut. Your left neighbor hands you a drink. Name whose it is. Wrong: drink 3.

title: The Flamingo
rules: Stand on one leg with your eyes shut for 10 seconds. Wobble or peek: drink 3.

title: Swirl, Sniff, Lie
rules: Review your drink like a sommelier for 15 seconds. Crack a smile: drink 3.

title: The Toast
rules: Toast your right neighbor, sincerely, for 20 seconds. Anyone laughs: you drink 3.

title: Falling Rack
rules: The wine rack tips, one bottle at a time, like dominoes. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Domino'd. Drink 6. 2-8: Domino'd. Drink 3. 9-19: You catch the last one. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You catch the last one. Give 4.

title: Merlot Stairs
rules: The stairs are slick with spilled merlot. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Down on your ass, in red. Drink 4 standing up. 2-8: Down on your ass, in red. Drink 2 standing up. 9-19: Not a drop on you. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! Not a drop on you. Give 4.

title: Sulfite Cloud
rules: A cracked cask puffs out a cloud of sulfites. Instant headache. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Migraine. Drink 4 and rub your temples. 2-8: Migraine. Drink 2 and rub your temples. 9-19: You duck under it. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You duck under it. Give 4.

title: Cork Mines
rules: The floor is covered in corks. Some of them click. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Pop. Drink 4. 2-8: Pop. Drink 2. 9-19: You tiptoe through. Give 2 to whoever walks loudest. 20-20: Natural 20! You tiptoe through. Give 4 to whoever walks loudest.

title: Fruit Fly Swarm
rules: A cloud of fruit flies off the dump bucket, and they brought friends. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! In your mouth. Drink 4 with a hand over your glass. 2-6: In your mouth. Drink 2 with a hand over your glass. 7-19: Swatted. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! Swatted. Give 4.

title: The Book Club
rules: Four women with one book none of them read, and a lot of opinions about you. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! They have notes. Drink 4. 2-6: They have notes. Drink 2. 7-19: You've read it. They scatter. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You've read it. They scatter. Give 4.

title: Cork Goblin
rules: A goblin with a corkscrew for a hand and nothing to open. Then he sees you. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He opens you. Drink 6. 2-6: He opens you. Drink 3. 7-19: You hand him a screw-top. He weeps. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You hand him a screw-top. He weeps. Give 6.

title: Rosé Elemental
rules: A pink spirit that says 'rosé all day' and means it as a threat. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! All day it is. Drink 6. 2-6: All day it is. Drink 3. 7-19: You call it blush wine and it dies. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You call it blush wine and it dies. Give 6.

title: Tannin Troll
rules: It dries out every mouth in the room. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-5: Your tongue sticks to your teeth. Drink 3. 6-12: You out-spit it. Give 3.

title: The Palate Test
rules: Your left neighbor names three wines, one made up. Spot the fake. Wrong: drink 3.

title: Sediment Pit
rules: The bottom of the barrel is a pit, and the pit is all dregs. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You wade through. Drink 4, and chew. 2-8: You wade through. Drink 2, and chew. 9-19: You vault it. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You vault it. Give 4.

title: The Gender Reveal
rules: A lost gender reveal party wants you to guess. They have a smoke cannon. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Wrong guess, and the cannon goes off. Drink 4. 2-6: Wrong guess, and the cannon goes off. Drink 2. 7-19: You leave before the smoke. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You leave before the smoke. Give 4.

title: The Wine Snob
rules: He swirls, he sniffs, he says you'd like something approachable. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Approachable. Drink 8, and say it's 'fun'. 2-9: Approachable. Drink 4, and say it's 'fun'. 10-19: You pour his '82 into a Solo cup. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You pour his '82 into a Solo cup. Give 8.

title: Grape Elemental
rules: Two tons of grapes, stomped into rage. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Stomped. Drink 8, then stomp your feet for 5 seconds. 2-9: Stomped. Drink 4, then stomp your feet for 5 seconds. 10-19: Raisin. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! Raisin. Give 8.

title: The Cellar Master
rules: He knows every bottle, and you broke one. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He makes you sweep. Drink 8. 2-9: He makes you sweep. Drink 4. 10-19: You blame the cat. He believes you. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You blame the cat. He believes you. Give 8.

title: The Wine Influencer
rules: Two million followers and a ring light. She needs you in her story. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You're the background. Drink 8, and pose. 2-9: You're the background. Drink 4, and pose. 10-19: You photobomb her. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You photobomb her. Give 8.

title: Count Corkula
rules: He does not drink... blood. He drinks pinot. Yours. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He drains your glass. Drink 8. 2-8: He drains your glass. Drink 4. 9-19: A stake through the cork. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! Sunlight. Everyone else drinks 3.

title: The Cask Queen
rules: She sits on a throne of barrels and judges your palate. Curtsy, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Off with your glass. Finish your drink. 2-8: Your palate is basic. Drink 4. 9-19: You knock out a barrel. She tumbles. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You knock out a barrel. She tumbles. Give 10.

title: Château Ghoul
rules: A ghoul in a beret who thinks your wine is beneath you. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He sneers you to death. Drink 8. 2-8: He sneers you to death. Drink 4. 9-19: You hand him a White Claw. He dissolves. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! He dissolves into a nice rosé. Everyone else drinks 3.

title: The Grand Sommelier
rules: Ten feet tall, a tastevin on a chain, and he has never been wrong. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He spits your drink back in your glass. Drink 8. 2-8: He names your drink, your year and your ex. Drink 4. 9-19: He calls your boxed wine a Bordeaux. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! He calls your boxed wine a Bordeaux. Give 10.

title: The Barrel Room
rules: Two hundred barrels, one of them alive, and they're all rolling. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Rolled flat. Drink 8. 2-8: Rolled flat. Drink 4. 9-19: You find the live one and tap it. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You surf a barrel out. Everyone else drinks 3.

title: Bachelor Ghosts
rules: The ghosts of a 1998 bachelor party want one more round. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You're in the round. Drink 8 and tell your worst wedding story. 2-8: You're in the round. Drink 4 and tell your worst wedding story. 9-19: You exorcise them with karaoke. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You exorcise them with karaoke. Give 8.

title: The Ex Wraith
rules: A wraith with your ex's face reads your old texts aloud, with feeling. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It reads the drafts. Finish your drink. 2-8: Every word lands. Drink 4. 9-19: You read theirs back. Give 4 to whoever has the worst ex. 20-20: Natural 20! You read theirs back. Give 8 to whoever has the worst ex.

title: Bone Sommelier
rules: A skeleton in a sommelier's chain rates your drink. Out of ten, it's a two. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Shamed. Drink 8. 2-8: Shamed. Drink 4. 9-19: You pour his on the floor. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You pour his on the floor. Give 8.

title: Leech Swarm
rules: Leeches that drink blood and, apparently, Fireball. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! They latch on and won't let go. Drink 6. 2-8: They latch on and won't let go. Drink 3. 9-19: You salt them. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You salt them. Give 8.

title: Hex Witch
rules: A witch who reads tarot and your browser history. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Hexed. Drink 6, and confess your last search. 2-8: Hexed. Drink 3, and confess your last search. 9-19: You flip her table. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You flip her table. Give 8.

title: Vampire Bro
rules: A vampire in a backwards cap who only drinks from frat boys. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He makes an exception. Drink 8. 2-8: He makes an exception. Drink 4. 9-19: Garlic knots to the face. He drops something. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! Garlic knots to the face. He drops something. Give 6.

title: Crypt Crawler
rules: Something with a hundred legs and one beer gut. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-6: It crawls up your shirt. Drink 4, and shake it out. 7-12: You stomp it flat. Give 4.

title: Hungover Mummy
rules: A mummy wrapped in bar napkins, hungover for three thousand years. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It throws up sand on you. Drink 8. 2-8: It throws up sand on you. Drink 4. 9-19: You hand it a Gatorade. It weeps. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You hand it a Gatorade. It weeps. Give 8.

title: Karaoke Banshee
rules: A banshee with a mic and a song list. She's picked yours. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Total Eclipse of the Heart. Sing the chorus, then drink 4. 2-2: She hits the high note. Your ears bleed. Drink 4. 3-3: You unplug the mic. Give 3. 4-4: You out-sing her. Give 4. 5-5: You duet. It's beautiful. Give 4. 6-6: You hit a note so bad she flees. Everyone else drinks 2.

title: The Lich's Accountant
rules: He's doing the Lich's taxes, and you're a deduction. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Audited. Drink 8. 2-8: Audited. Drink 4. 9-19: You find an error in his math. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You find an error in his math. Give 8.

title: Tomb of Silence
rules: No laughing in the tomb. The table gets 30 seconds to crack you. Laugh: drink 4.

title: The Bone Tower
rules: Stack the empties into a tower that stands for 5 seconds. Collapse: drink 4.

title: Backwards Chant
rules: Wake the dead: say the alphabet from Z to A in 20 seconds. Stumble: drink 4.

title: The Séance
rules: Hands joined, you summon a spirit. Make someone laugh in 20 seconds, or drink 4.

title: Collapsing Floor
rules: The floor gives way under you. Roll d20 to grab the edge.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You fall a whole floor. Drink 6. 2-10: You fall a whole floor. Drink 3. 11-19: You hang on. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You hang on. Give 4.

title: Dart Wall
rules: Little holes in both walls. Then a click. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Darted, in the ass. Drink 6 standing. 2-10: Darted, in the ass. Drink 3 standing. 11-19: You limbo under them. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You limbo under them. Give 4.

title: Fog of Regret
rules: A green fog that smells like the tequila from your 21st. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Flashbacks. Drink 6. 2-10: Flashbacks. Drink 3. 11-19: You hold your breath. Give 2 to whoever had the worst 21st. 20-20: Natural 20! You hold your breath. Give 4 to whoever had the worst 21st.

title: Rolling Skull
rules: A giant stone skull comes down the corridor, Indiana Jones style. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It rolls you flat. Drink 6. 2-10: It rolls you flat. Drink 3. 11-19: You dive into a side tomb. Give 2, and hum the theme. 20-20: Natural 20! You dive into a side tomb. Give 4, and hum the theme.

title: Skeleton Crew
rules: A skeleton bachelorette party wants you to do a shot off a femur. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Off the femur. Drink 6. 2-8: Off the femur. Drink 3. 9-19: You knock their bones loose. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You knock their bones loose. Give 6.

title: The Ghoul Choir
rules: Twelve ghouls in robes singing your name, off key. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You join in. Drink 6. 2-8: You join in. Drink 3. 9-19: You conduct them into a wall. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You conduct them into a wall. Give 6.

title: Zombie Roommate
rules: Your old roommate, undead, still owes you rent and still has your hoodie. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He moves back in. Drink 8. 2-8: He moves back in. Drink 4. 9-19: You change the locks. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You change the locks. Give 8.

title: Gym Ghoul
rules: A ghoul who has skipped leg day for three hundred years. He needs a spotter. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He drops the bar on you. Drink 8. 2-8: He drops the bar on you. Drink 4. 9-19: You out-lift a corpse. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You out-lift a corpse. Give 8.

title: Skeleton Mariachi
rules: Three skeletons with guitars. They won't stop until someone dances. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: You dance, badly. Drink 4. 2-2: They serenade your ex. Drink 4. 3-3: You request a slow one. Give 3. 4-4: You pay them to leave. Give 4. 5-5: They play your song. Give 4. 6-6: You join the band. Everyone else drinks 1.

title: Your Own Eulogy
rules: Give your own eulogy in 10 seconds. The table says if it moved them. Not moved: drink 4.

title: The Grabbing Hand
rules: A coffin lid slides open as you pass, and a hand grabs your ankle. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It pulls. Drink 6. 2-10: It pulls. Drink 3. 11-19: You stamp on it and it lets go. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You stamp on it and it lets go. Give 6.

title: The Ghost Tour
rules: A ghost tour thinks you're part of the show. They want photos. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You do the voice. Drink 6, then moan for them. 2-8: You do the voice. Drink 3, then moan for them. 9-19: You charge them for the photos. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You charge them for the photos. Give 6.

title: The Crypt Keeper's Mom
rules: She's been waiting up. Do you know what time it is? Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Grounded, in a tomb. Drink 10, then text your mom. 2-11: Grounded, in a tomb. Drink 5, then text your mom. 12-19: You hug her. She packs you something for the road. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You hug her. She packs you something for the road. Give 10.

title: Death's Intern
rules: Death's unpaid intern is behind on quota, and you'll do. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Filed. Drink 10. 2-11: Filed. Drink 5. 12-19: You fill out his forms wrong. He runs, and drops his badge. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You fill out his forms wrong. He runs, and drops his badge. Give 10.

title: The Bone Dragon
rules: A dragon skeleton with a tiny hat, guarding a pile of bottle caps. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It lies down on you, hat and all. Drink 10. 2-11: It lies down on you, hat and all. Drink 5. 12-19: You take the hat. It deflates. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You take the hat. It deflates. Give 10.

title: The Banshee Bride
rules: She's been at the altar since 1888, and you look just like him. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! She screams your name. Drink 10. 2-11: She screams your name. Drink 5. 12-19: You object. She vanishes and drops her ring. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You object. She vanishes and drops her ring. Give 10.

title: Hangover Hydra
rules: Every head you cut off grows back with a headache. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It breathes regret. Drink 10. 2-10: It breathes regret. Drink 5. 11-19: A head comes off. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! Clean through the neck. Everyone else drinks 3.

title: The Bouncer
rules: Seven feet of door guy in a tight black tee. Nobody gets past him. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He throws you out. Finish your drink. 2-10: He throws you down the stairs. Drink 5. 11-19: You get past one arm. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You get past one arm. Give 8.

title: DJ Ossuary
rules: A skeleton DJ, Macarena on loop. Everyone does the Macarena, then you roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He drops the bass on you. Drink 10. 2-10: He drops the bass on you. Drink 5. 11-19: You yank a cable. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You steal the aux. Everyone else drinks 3.

title: The Lich Lord
rules: He keeps his soul in a shot glass and he's daring you to drink it. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You drink his soul. Finish your drink. 2-10: His soul is Jägermeister. Drink 5. 11-19: You smash the shot glass. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You smash the shot glass. Give 8.

title: Ghost of Closings Past
rules: Every bar that ever closed on you, back, and they all want one more. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! They kick you out of every one. Drink 10. 2-10: They kick you out of every one. Drink 5. 11-19: You pay the last tab. They rest. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You buy the whole bar. Everyone else drinks 3.

title: Gator Junior
rules: Someone flushed a baby gator in 1995. He is not a baby. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Chomp. Drink 8, and do the gator chomp with your arms. 2-8: Chomp. Drink 4, and do the gator chomp with your arms. 9-19: You give him a belly rub. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You give him a belly rub. Give 8.

title: Toilet Mimic
rules: The only toilet down here is licking its lips. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! The full swirlie. Finish your drink. 2-8: Swirlie. Drink 4. 9-19: You flush it. Give 4 to whoever takes longest in the bathroom. 20-20: Natural 20! You flush it. Give 8 to whoever takes longest in the bathroom.

title: Hazmat Goblin
rules: A goblin in a hazmat suit who loves it down here. Loves it. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He hugs you, suit and all. Drink 8. 2-8: He hugs you, suit and all. Drink 4. 9-19: You pull his air hose. He leaves something smoky behind. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You pull his air hose. He leaves something smoky behind. Give 6.

title: Sludge Bro
rules: A pile of sludge in a muscle shirt asks if you even lift. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You don't. Drink 8, and do five push-ups or drink 4 more. 2-8: You don't. Drink 4, and do five push-ups or drink 2 more. 9-19: You lift him, into the drain. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You lift him, into the drain. Give 8.

title: Pizza Rat Prime
rules: The original pizza rat, nine feet tall now and still dragging the slice. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Slice to the face. Drink 8. 2-8: Slice to the face. Drink 4. 9-19: You take the slice. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You take the slice and eat it. Give 8.

title: The Drain Witch
rules: She brews in the runoff, and she's offering you a sip. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You sip. Drink 6. 2-8: You sip. Drink 3. 9-19: You pour it back. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You pour it back. Give 8.

title: Fatberg Spawn
rules: A baby fatberg made of wet wipes and grease. It wants its mom. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It clings. Drink 6. 2-8: It clings. Drink 3. 9-19: You flush it. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You flush it. Give 8.

title: Sewer Mutant
rules: A mutant with three arms and a fourth beer wants to arm-wrestle. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-6: It has three arms. Drink 4. 7-12: You win, somehow. Give 4.

title: A Bitter Turtle
rules: A giant turtle who taught four boys karate and got nothing. He wants a fight. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Nunchucked. Drink 4. 2-2: He lectures you on gratitude. Drink 4. 3-3: You bow first. He respects it. Give 3. 4-4: You flip him on his shell. Give 4. 5-5: You order him a pizza. He cries. Give 4. 6-6: You do a perfect crane kick. Everyone else drinks 2.

title: The Echo Bat
rules: A bat that repeats everything you say, louder. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It repeats your secret. Drink 8. 2-8: It repeats your secret. Drink 4. 9-19: You say nothing. It explodes. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You say nothing. It explodes. Give 8.

title: The Smell
rules: Hold your nose and describe your day for 30 seconds. Let go: drink 4.

title: The Pipe
rules: Crawl under the table and out the other side without touching a leg. Touch one: drink 4.

title: The Echo
rules: Talk for 30 seconds while everyone repeats your last word back at you. Stop: drink 4.

title: Rat Race
rules: Race your left neighbor: take a sip, then say 'rat' three times. Slower: drink 4.

title: The Big Flush
rules: Somewhere above, a whole bar flushes at once. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Swept down the pipe. Drink 6. 2-10: Swept down the pipe. Drink 3. 11-19: You grab a ladder. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You grab a ladder. Give 4.

title: Loose Grate
rules: The grate under your foot isn't attached to anything. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! One leg down a drain. Drink 6 on one leg. 2-10: One leg down a drain. Drink 3 on one leg. 11-19: You hop off. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You hop off. Give 4.

title: Swamp Gas
rules: Somebody lit a cigarette. Down here. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Whoomph. Drink 6, and pat out your hair. 2-10: Whoomph. Drink 3, and pat out your hair. 11-19: You dive into the sludge. Give 2 to whoever you blame. 20-20: Natural 20! You dive into the sludge. Give 4 to whoever you blame.

title: The Slime Slide
rules: The floor tilts, and it's greased. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Down the slide, face first. Drink 6. 2-10: Down the slide, face first. Drink 3. 11-19: You surf it. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You surf it. Give 4.

title: Roach Conga
rules: The roaches are doing a conga line, and now you're in it. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You conga'd. Drink 6, and lead a conga to the fridge. 2-8: You conga'd. Drink 3, and lead a conga to the fridge. 9-19: You break the line. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You break the line. Give 6.

title: The Gator Gang
rules: Three gators in leather jackets, and one of them has a switchblade. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! They take your wallet. Drink 6. 2-8: They take your wallet. Drink 3. 9-19: You out-cool them. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You out-cool them. Give 6.

title: The Flushed Goldfish
rules: A goldfish flushed in 2003 grew to the size of a van. It remembers. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It remembers you. Drink 8. 2-8: It remembers you. Drink 4. 9-19: You say sorry and it forgives you. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You say sorry and it forgives you. Give 8.

title: The Rat Don
rules: A rat in a fedora says that's a nice drink. Shame if something happened to it. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Something happens to it. Drink 8. 2-8: Something happens to it. Drink 4. 9-19: You make him an offer he can't refuse. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You make him an offer he can't refuse. Give 8.

title: Pipe Octopus
rules: Eight arms out of eight pipes, all at once. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-6: It grabs your drink with all eight. Drink 4. 7-12: You tie two arms together. Give 4.

title: Hold Your Breath
rules: Hold your breath for 20 seconds while the table describes the smell. Gasp early: drink 4.

title: The Manhole Cover
rules: The manhole cover above you is spinning loose. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It lands on your foot. Drink 6. 2-10: It lands on your foot. Drink 3. 11-19: You catch it like a frisbee. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You catch it like a frisbee. Give 6.

title: The LARPers
rules: Four LARPers in foam armor think the sewer is their quest, and you're the orc. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! A foam sword to the face. Drink 6, then growl. 2-8: A foam sword to the face. Drink 3, then growl. 9-19: You surrender, and they leave happy. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You surrender, and they leave happy. Give 6.

title: Clog Beast
rules: Everything anyone ever flushed, fused into one angry clog. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It backs up on you. Drink 10. 2-11: It backs up on you. Drink 5. 12-19: You plunge it. Inside: something shiny. Don't ask. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You plunge it. Inside: something shiny. Don't ask. Give 10.

title: Rat Captain
rules: A rat in a captain's hat with a tiny cutlass and a big grudge. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Keelhauled. Drink 10, and say 'aye aye, captain'. 2-11: Keelhauled. Drink 5, and say 'aye aye, captain'. 12-19: You take his hat and his ship. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You take his hat and his ship. Give 10.

title: The Sewer Kingpin
rules: He runs every pipe from here to the river, and he's heard about you. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You owe him now. Drink 10. 2-11: You owe him now. Drink 5. 12-19: You flip him. He works for you now. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You flip him. He works for you now. Give 10.

title: The Sewer Siren
rules: She sings from the outflow pipe, and everyone wants to follow. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You follow. Drink 10, and hum her song. 2-11: You follow. Drink 5, and hum her song. 12-19: You cover your ears and sing louder. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You cover your ears and sing louder. Give 10.

title: The Fatberg
rules: A hundred tons of grease and wet wipes the size of a bus, and it's angry. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It absorbs a bit of you. Drink 10. 2-10: It absorbs a bit of you. Drink 5. 11-19: A chunk comes off. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You blast it with a fire hose. Everyone else drinks 3.

title: Alligator Al
rules: A twelve-foot gator in a bowling shirt who runs the sewer's only bar. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Al doesn't like your face. Drink 10. 2-10: Al doesn't like your face. Drink 5. 11-19: You bowl him a strike. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! Gutter ball, and he's in it. Everyone else drinks 3.

title: The Plumber King
rules: Crowned in a toilet seat with a plunger for a scepter. He demands tribute. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He crowns you with the seat. Finish your drink. 2-10: Plunged. Drink 5. 11-19: You snap the plunger. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You snap the plunger. Give 8.

title: Mama Gator
rules: Gator Junior's mother has heard what you did. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! She adopts you. Finish your drink, then call her mom. 2-10: She sits on you, gently, for an hour. Drink 5. 11-19: You apologize to her face. She weeps. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You apologize to her face. She weeps. Give 8.

title: The Pipe Worm
rules: Eighty years in the plumbing, and now it's as long as the city. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It wraps around you twice. Drink 10. 2-10: It wraps around you twice. Drink 5. 11-19: You tie it in a knot. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You tie it in a bow. Everyone else drinks 3.

title: Sommelier Kraken
rules: A kraken with a wine glass in every arm, and every glass is yours. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Squeezed. Drink 10. 2-10: Squeezed. Drink 5. 11-19: Calamari. Give 5, split however you like. 20-20: Natural 20! Calamari. Give 10, split however you like.

title: Last Orders Siren
rules: A siren sings one more drink, and it's beautiful. Roll d20 to resist.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You swim to her. Finish your drink. 2-10: You swim to her. Finish half your drink. 11-19: You stuff your ears with limes. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You stuff your ears with limes. Give 10.

title: The Drowned Regular
rules: He's been at the bottom of the bar since 1987 and you're on his stool. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He takes it back. Drink 10, and swap seats with your left neighbor. 2-10: He takes it back. Drink 5, and swap seats with your left neighbor. 11-19: You buy him one. He fades away. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You buy him one. He fades away. Give 10.

title: Foam Leviathan
rules: A head of foam the size of a city bus rises out of the taps. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It washes over you. Drink 10, and wear the mustache. 2-10: It washes over you. Drink 5, and wear the mustache. 11-19: You blow the head off. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You blow the head off. Give 10.

title: Piranha Shots
rules: A school of piranhas lives in the shot glasses. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: They bite back. Drink 5. 2-2: They bite your lip. Drink 5. 3-3: They swim up your nose. Drink 5. 4-4: You drink them first. Give 4. 5-5: You net them with a coaster. Give 5. 6-6: You set them loose on the bar. Everyone else drinks 2.

title: Your Merfolk Ex
rules: Your ex is a merfolk now and says they're doing amazing without you. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! They are. Drink 8. 2-10: They are. Drink 4. 11-19: You're doing amazing too. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You're doing amazing too. Give 10.

title: The Text-Them Eel
rules: An eel slides up and whispers: text them. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You text them. Drink 8, and show the table your last text. 2-10: You text them. Drink 4, and show the table your last text. 11-19: You bite the eel first. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You bite the eel first. Give 10.

title: Tap Mimic
rules: One of the taps is breathing. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It pours itself into you. Drink 10. 2-10: It pours itself into you. Drink 5. 11-19: You yank it out by the handle. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You yank it out by the handle. Give 8.

title: The Pirate Ghost
rules: A ghost pirate who drowned at this bar in 1803 wants his rum back. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He takes it in blood. Drink 10. 2-10: He takes it in blood. Drink 5. 11-19: You hand him a rum and coke. He's confused, then grateful. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You hand him a rum and coke. He's confused, then grateful. Give 10.

title: Snorkel Shark
rules: A shark in a snorkel mask, circling the pool table. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-7: It takes a bite of your shoe. Drink 5. 8-12: You hit it with a pool cue. Give 5.

title: The Drowned Choir
rules: Hum a song until the table names it. 20 seconds. Nobody gets it: drink 5.

title: Rising Water
rules: The water's at your chin. Hold your breath for 30 seconds. Breathe early: drink 5.

title: The Last Round
rules: Last round's on you: name everyone's drink order from memory. Miss one: drink 5.

title: Sea Shanty
rules: Lead the table in a sea shanty. If nobody joins in by the second line, drink 5.

title: Rip Current
rules: The floor is a river now. Roll d20 to swim for it.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Swept away. Drink 8. 2-12: Swept away. Drink 4. 13-19: You ride it out. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You ride it out. Give 6.

title: Barnacle Stool
rules: You sat down. Now you can't stand up. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Fused to it. Drink 8, and stay seated until your next turn. 2-12: Fused to it. Drink 4, and stay seated until your next turn. 13-19: You rip free, mostly. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You rip free, mostly. Give 6.

title: Undertow Tap
rules: You lean in for a pour and the tap pulls you under. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Swallowed. Drink 8. 2-12: Swallowed. Drink 4. 13-19: You kick off the bar. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You kick off the bar. Give 6.

title: The Drain Vortex
rules: Someone pulled the plug on the whole room. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Round and round. Spin twice, then drink 8. 2-12: Round and round. Spin twice, then drink 4. 13-19: You grab the jukebox and hold on. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You grab the jukebox and hold on. Give 6.

title: Happy Hour Eels
rules: Two eels in party hats want to buy you a drink. You know what that means. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Bitten, twice. Drink 8. 2-10: Bitten, twice. Drink 4. 11-19: You tie them in a knot. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You tie them in a knot. Give 8.

title: Mermaid Bachelorettes
rules: A mermaid bachelorette party in sashes, and they're out of prosecco. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! They take yours. Drink 8. 2-10: They take yours. Drink 4. 11-19: You find them prosecco. They cry. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You find them prosecco. They cry. Give 8.

title: The Kelp Bouncer
rules: A bouncer made of kelp. Your name's not on the waterlogged list. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He wraps you up and throws you in. Drink 10. 2-10: He wraps you up and throws you in. Drink 5. 11-19: You slip through his fronds. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You slip through his fronds. Give 10.

title: Barnacle Bro
rules: A bro so covered in barnacles he's mostly reef. He wants to arm wrestle. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Reefed. Drink 10. 2-10: Reefed. Drink 5. 11-19: You scrape him off the bar. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You scrape him off the bar. Give 10.

title: Jellyfish Shots
rules: A tray of glowing jellyfish shots drifts past. Grab one. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Stung. Drink 5. 2-2: Stung twice. Drink 5. 3-3: That was a real jellyfish. Drink 5. 4-4: Lime jello. Give 4. 5-5: Blue raspberry. Give 4. 6-6: You grab the whole tray. Everyone else drinks 2.

title: Bail Out
rules: Mime bailing water out of the booth for 20 seconds without laughing. Laugh: drink 5.

title: Floating Stools
rules: The bar stools float now, and one is drifting at your knees. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It takes your legs out. Drink 8. 2-12: It takes your legs out. Drink 4. 13-19: You ride it like a surfboard. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You ride it like a surfboard. Give 6.

title: The Fishing Charter
rules: Six dads on a fishing charter, lost since Tuesday, still casting. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Hooked by the ear. Drink 8. 2-10: Hooked by the ear. Drink 4. 11-19: You point them at the deep end. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You point them at the deep end. Give 8.

title: Sea Hag of Table Six
rules: She's run a tab since the flood, and she's settling it on you. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Settled. Drink 12. 2-13: Settled. Drink 6. 14-19: She pays you in pearls. Give 6. 20-20: Natural 20! She pays you in pearls. Give 12.

title: Shark Bartender
rules: A shark in a vest, polishing glasses with its teeth, is cutting someone off. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It's you. Drink 12. 2-13: It's you. Drink 6. 14-19: You punch it on the nose, like the documentaries said. Give 6. 20-20: Natural 20! You punch it on the nose, like the documentaries said. Give 12.

title: The Deep One
rules: Something under the bar has been drinking every spill for a century. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It drinks you a bit. Drink 12. 2-13: It drinks you a bit. Drink 6. 14-19: You pour it a pint. It sinks back, happy. Give 6. 20-20: Natural 20! You pour it a pint. It sinks back, happy. Give 12.

title: The Lighthouse Keeper
rules: He hasn't seen a soul in forty years, and he's not letting you leave. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He tells you about the forty years. Drink 12. 2-13: He tells you about the forty years. Drink 6. 14-19: You fix his light, and he lets you go. Give 6. 20-20: Natural 20! You fix his light, and he lets you go. Give 12.

title: Deep Fryer Demon
rules: It'll fry anything. It's looking at your hand. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Battered. Drink 10. 2-10: Battered. Drink 5. 11-19: You throw ice in it. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You throw ice in it. Give 10.

title: Line Cook Golem
rules: Seven feet of burns and tattoos, ten tickets deep, and you're in the way. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Behind! Drink 10. 2-10: Behind! Drink 5. 11-19: You run his food. He respects you. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You run his food. He respects you. Give 10.

title: Sentient Sourdough
rules: The starter has been fed for forty years. It wants more. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It rises over you. Drink 10. 2-10: It rises over you. Drink 5. 11-19: You punch it down. Give 5 to whoever's most likely to own a starter. 20-20: Natural 20! You punch it down. Give 10 to whoever's most likely to own a starter.

title: Garlic Breath Wraith
rules: A wraith that only ever exhales. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You'll taste it for a week. Drink 8. 2-10: You'll taste it for a week. Drink 4. 11-19: You hold your breath. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You hold your breath. Give 10.

title: The Expo
rules: The expo is screaming for hands, and you have hands. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Plates everywhere. Drink 5. 2-2: You drop table six's steak. Drink 5. 3-3: You burn your palm on a plate. Drink 5. 4-4: Order up. Give 4. 5-5: Order up, hot and fast. Give 5. 6-6: You run six plates at once. Everyone else drinks 2.

title: Food Critic Ghoul
rules: A ghoul with a notebook. One star, and he hasn't eaten yet. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! One star. Drink 10, and give the room a one-star review out loud. 2-10: One star. Drink 5, and give the room a one-star review out loud. 11-19: You comp his meal. He tips you his hip flask. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You comp his meal. He tips you his hip flask. Give 8.

title: Cold Room Yeti
rules: Something lives in the cold room, and it ate all the shrimp. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It locks you in. Finish your drink. 2-10: Cold hug. Drink 5. 11-19: You lock it in. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You lock it in. Give 10.

title: Dish Pit Horror
rules: Something under the dish pit water has been eating forks. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-7: It eats your fork. Drink 5. 8-12: You pull the plug. Give 5.

title: The Screaming Chef
rules: A ghost chef who calls everything raw. It's not even food. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You're an idiot sandwich. Drink 10. 2-10: You're an idiot sandwich. Drink 5. 11-19: You serve him something perfect. He goes quiet. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You serve him something perfect. He goes quiet. Give 10.

title: Rogue Rotisserie
rules: Twelve chickens on a spit, turning, and turning toward you. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Basted. Drink 10. 2-10: Basted. Drink 5. 11-19: You carve your way out. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You carve your way out. Give 10.

title: Yes, Chef
rules: For 30 seconds, answer everything anyone says with 'Yes, chef!' Miss one: drink 5.

title: Four Plates
rules: Carry four empties on one arm across the room and back. Drop one: drink 5.

title: The Hot Sauce Wall
rules: Name ten hot sauces, real or made up, in 20 seconds. Stumble: drink 5.

title: The Pitch
rules: Pitch the table a new dish in 20 seconds. Fewer than half would eat it: drink 5.

title: Grease Fire
rules: Somebody threw water on it. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Singed. Drink 8. 2-12: Singed. Drink 4. 13-19: You smother it with a lid. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You smother it with a lid. Give 6.

title: Wet Floor
rules: There was a sign. You ignored it. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Down. Drink 8, and lie on the floor for 5 seconds. 2-12: Down. Drink 4, and lie on the floor for 5 seconds. 13-19: You skate it. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You skate it. Give 6.

title: The Swinging Door
rules: One door, in and out, and a server is coming through with a full tray. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Tray to the face. Drink 8. 2-12: Tray to the face. Drink 4. 13-19: You spin past. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You spin past. Give 6.

title: The Mandoline
rules: The guard is off the mandoline and it's slicing on its own. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Thinly sliced. Drink 8. 2-12: Thinly sliced. Drink 4. 13-19: You slide the guard back on. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You slide the guard back on. Give 6.

title: Raccoon Crew
rules: Two raccoons in chef's hats are stealing the bread. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! They take your fries too. Drink 8. 2-10: They take your fries too. Drink 4. 11-19: You chase them out. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You chase them out. Give 8.

title: The Brunch Crowd
rules: It's 2 a.m. and a brunch crowd has arrived demanding bottomless mimosas. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Bottomless. Drink 8. 2-10: Bottomless. Drink 4. 11-19: You tell them it's dinner. Their minds break. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You tell them it's dinner. Their minds break. Give 8.

title: Microwave Ghost
rules: The ghost of every fish ever microwaved in the break room. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You smell like it now. Drink 10. 2-10: You smell like it now. Drink 5. 11-19: You open a window and it's gone. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You open a window and it's gone. Give 10.

title: The Rat Chef
rules: A rat under a chef's hat is steering the line cook. He wants your order. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He serves you. Drink 10. 2-10: He serves you. Drink 5. 11-19: You send it back. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You send it back. Give 10.

title: The Ticket Machine
rules: The ticket printer won't stop. Two hundred orders, all for you. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-7: You're in the weeds. Drink 5. 8-12: Heard. Give 5.

title: The Order
rules: Repeat back every drink at the table, in order, from memory. Miss one: drink 5.

title: The Hot Pan
rules: Somebody left a pan on the burner, and the handle's glowing. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You grab it. Drink 8, then blow on your hand. 2-12: You grab it. Drink 4, then blow on your hand. 13-19: You use a towel like a pro. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You use a towel like a pro. Give 6.

title: The Food Truck Guys
rules: Two food truck guys broke in to rob your walk-in. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! They sell you your own food. Drink 8. 2-10: They sell you your own food. Drink 4. 11-19: You chase them off with a ladle. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You chase them off with a ladle. Give 8.

title: The Head Chef
rules: He's thrown a pan at everyone tonight. You're next. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! The pan. Drink 12. 2-13: The pan. Drink 6. 14-19: You say 'Heard, chef.' He's moved, and hands you his lucky knife. Give 6. 20-20: Natural 20! You say 'Heard, chef.' He's moved, and hands you his lucky knife. Give 12.

title: The Butcher
rules: The butcher is sharpening, and sharpening, and sharpening. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Filleted. Drink 12. 2-13: Filleted. Drink 6. 14-19: You take his apron. It's basically armor. Give 6. 20-20: Natural 20! You take his apron. It's basically armor. Give 12.

title: The Owner
rules: He's back from his third divorce and he's doing the books tonight. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He blames you for the books. Drink 12. 2-13: He blames you for the books. Drink 6. 14-19: You find the money. He makes you a partner. Give 6. 20-20: Natural 20! You find the money. He makes you a partner. Give 12.

title: The Celebrity Chef
rules: He has a TV show, a catchphrase and a temper, and you're on. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He calls you a donkey on camera. Drink 12. 2-13: He calls you a donkey on camera. Drink 6. 14-19: You make his signature dish better. Give 6. 20-20: Natural 20! You make his signature dish better. Give 12.

title: Hop Goblin
rules: A goblin made entirely of hops. It smells like an IPA lecture. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It explains bitterness units to you. Drink 6. 2-6: It explains bitterness units to you. Drink 3. 7-19: You tell it you prefer lager. It wilts. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You tell it you prefer lager. It wilts. Give 6.

title: The Yeast Beast
rules: A blob of live yeast, bubbling and very, very friendly. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It ferments on you. Drink 6. 2-6: It ferments on you. Drink 3. 7-19: You starve it of sugar. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You bake it into bread. Give 6.

title: The Craft Bro
rules: He brewed it himself, in his garage. It has notes of regret. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: You taste it. Drink 3. 2-2: You taste it again, to be polite. Drink 3. 3-3: You call it 'interesting'. Give 2. 4-4: You pour it in a plant. Give 3. 5-5: You ask for a lager. He leaves. Give 3. 6-6: You out-brew him on the spot. Everyone else drinks 1.

title: Mash Tun Monster
rules: Something lives in the mash tun, and it's sticky. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It pulls you in to the waist. Drink 6. 2-6: It pulls you in to the waist. Drink 3. 7-19: You stir it to death. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You stir it to death. Give 6.

title: The Brewer's Ghost
rules: He died tasting batch one, and he wants your opinion on batch two. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It's worse. Drink 6. 2-6: It's worse. Drink 3. 7-19: You lie beautifully. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You lie beautifully. Give 6.

title: Foam Ferrets
rules: A family of ferrets living in the foam, very fast. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-5: They go up your sleeve. Drink 3. 6-12: You cork them in a growler. Give 3.

title: Sour Mash Witch
rules: She brews sours, and her mood went sour years ago. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Puckered. Drink 6 through pursed lips. 2-6: Puckered. Drink 3 through pursed lips. 7-19: You sweeten her up. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You sweeten her up. Give 6.

title: Keg Ninja
rules: A ninja who fights only with keg taps, and he's good. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Tapped. Drink 6. 2-6: Tapped. Drink 3. 7-19: You disarm him. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You disarm him. Give 4.

title: Bottle Cap Crab
rules: A crab with a shell made of bottle caps and a temper. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Pinched. Drink 6. 2-6: Pinched. Drink 3. 7-19: You collect the caps. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You collect the caps. Give 6.

title: The Gruit Druid
rules: A druid brewing beer like it's 1300 and judging you for it. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! A hangover from 1300 hits you. Drink 6. 2-6: A hangover from 1300 hits you. Drink 3. 7-19: You pour him a cold lager. He converts. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You pour him a cold lager. He converts. Give 6.

title: Name That Brand
rules: Name five beer brands in 10 seconds. Stumble: drink 3.

title: The Perfect Pour
rules: Pour a mime pint, narrating like a pro, for 15 seconds. Anyone laughs: you drink 3.

title: The Brewer's Riddle
rules: Your right neighbor names a drink. Sum up its taste in one word. Booed: drink 3.

title: The Bottling Line
rules: Pass an empty bottle around the table and back. Anyone laughs: you drink 3.

title: Bottle Bombs
rules: A whole crate of overcarbonated bottles is going off. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Glass and foam. Drink 4. 2-8: Glass and foam. Drink 2. 9-19: You dive behind a vat. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You dive behind a vat. Give 4.

title: The Grain Chute
rules: The grain chute opens right above you. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Buried in barley. Drink 4. 2-8: Buried in barley. Drink 2. 9-19: You surf it out. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You surf it out. Give 4.

title: CO2 Leak
rules: Something hisses, and everyone's voice drops an octave. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Barry White. Drink 4, then say something in your deepest voice. 2-8: Barry White. Drink 2, then say something in your deepest voice. 9-19: You find the valve. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You find the valve. Give 4.

title: Hot Wort
rules: The floor is covered in hot, sticky wort. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Down you go. Drink 4. 2-8: Down you go. Drink 2. 9-19: You moonwalk across. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You moonwalk across. Give 4.

title: The Brewery Tour
rules: A tour group in hairnets corners you for a photo. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You're in the brochure. Drink 4. 2-6: You're in the brochure. Drink 2. 7-19: You lead them into a vat. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You lead them into a vat. Give 4.

title: Bottle Gnomes
rules: Two gnomes are stealing bottles, and they saw you see them. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Hush money. Drink 4. 2-6: Hush money. Drink 2. 7-19: You take a cut. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You take a cut. Give 4.

title: Spent Grain Golem
rules: A golem of spent grain, still warm, looking for a bakery. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It crumbles all over you. Drink 6. 2-6: It crumbles all over you. Drink 3. 7-19: You feed it to the pigs out back. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You feed it to the pigs out back. Give 6.

title: Hazy Wraith
rules: A ghost so cloudy you can't see through it. It's 9 percent. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It haunts your palate. Drink 6. 2-6: It haunts your palate. Drink 3. 7-19: You hold it to the light and it flees. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You hold it to the light and it flees. Give 6.

title: Forklift Goblin
rules: A goblin learned to drive a forklift. He has not learned to stop. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: A pallet to the shins. Drink 3. 2-2: He reverses over your foot. Drink 3. 3-3: You dodge. Give 2. 4-4: You take the keys. Give 3. 5-5: You wave him into a vat. Give 3. 6-6: You ride the forks. Everyone else drinks 1.

title: Quality Control
rules: Say 'the brewer brewed better beer' five times fast. Trip up: drink 3.

title: The Loose Hose
rules: A wash-down hose is loose and whipping across the floor. Roll d20 to jump it.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It wraps your ankles. Drink 4. 2-8: It wraps your ankles. Drink 2. 9-19: You stamp it flat. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You stamp it flat. Give 4.

title: Homebrew Club
rules: Four beards with growlers want your opinion. All of it. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You give it. Drink 4. 2-6: You give it. Drink 2. 7-19: You say 'it's very you' and they leave. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You say 'it's very you' and they leave. Give 4.

title: The Brewmaster
rules: Forty years at the kettle, and you just called his stout 'fine'. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He makes you drink the whole flight. Drink 8. 2-9: He makes you drink the whole flight. Drink 4. 10-19: You call it his best. He weeps. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You call it his best. He weeps. Give 8.

title: Barrel-Aged Horror
rules: Something has been aging in barrel 9 for twelve years. It's out. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It's very strong. Drink 8. 2-9: It's very strong. Drink 4. 10-19: You cork it back in. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You cork it back in. Give 8.

title: The Hostile Takeover
rules: A rival brewery is taking over the taps, one tap handle at a time. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! They take your tap. Drink 8. 2-9: They take your tap. Drink 4. 10-19: You take theirs. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You take theirs. Give 8.

title: The Head Brewer
rules: She's tasted every batch since 1998, and she hates yours. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! She pours it out in front of you. Drink 8. 2-9: She pours it out in front of you. Drink 4. 10-19: She asks for the recipe. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! She asks for the recipe. Give 8.

title: The Fermenter
rules: A forty-foot fermentation tank, under pressure, and it's angry. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It blows its lid on you. Drink 8. 2-8: It blows its lid on you. Drink 4. 9-19: You open the valve. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You drink it down to the yeast. Everyone else drinks 3.

title: King Hop
rules: A crowned hop cone the size of a car demands you call it hoppy. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You call it malty. Finish your drink. 2-8: Too bitter. Drink 4. 9-19: You dry-hop the king. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You dry-hop the king. Give 10.

title: The Beer Snob Lich
rules: Undead, and still telling everyone about Belgian monks. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He lectures you to death. Drink 8. 2-8: He lectures you to death. Drink 4. 9-19: You fall asleep, and it kills him. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You out-snob him. Everyone else drinks 3.

title: The Keg Kraken
rules: Eight arms, each one a tap, all of them pouring at you. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It pours down your throat. Finish your drink. 2-8: Eight pours at once. Drink 4. 9-19: You tie its taps in a knot. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You tie its taps in a knot. Give 10.

title: The Brewery Owner
rules: He just sold to a conglomerate and he's celebrating on you. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He sprays you with champagne. Drink 8. 2-8: He sprays you with champagne. Drink 4. 9-19: You read the contract. He owes you. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You buy it back. Everyone else drinks 3.

title: Freezer Burn
rules: A steak that's been in here since 2009 and has become sentient and bitter. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It tastes like the freezer. Drink 8. 2-8: It tastes like the freezer. Drink 4. 9-19: You thaw it. It apologizes. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You thaw it. It apologizes. Give 8.

title: The Ice Wraith
rules: A ghost made of frost, breathing on the back of your neck. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Chills, the bad kind. Drink 8. 2-8: Chills, the bad kind. Drink 4. 9-19: You breathe back, harder. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! It melts into a puddle. Give 8.

title: The Frozen Bachelor
rules: A groom-to-be, frozen mid-shot at his bachelor party. He's thawing. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He finishes the shot on you. Drink 8. 2-8: He finishes the shot on you. Drink 4. 9-19: You get him to the church. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You get him to the church. Give 8.

title: Frost Giant Bartender
rules: Nine feet tall, ice for hands, and he says you're cut off. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He pours you a glacier. Drink 8. 2-8: He pours you a glacier. Drink 4. 9-19: You tip him. He warms right up. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You tip him. He warms right up. Give 8.

title: Brain Freeze
rules: It's not a monster. It's the pain behind your eyes, and it's winning. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-6: Full freeze. Drink 4, holding your forehead. 7-12: You press your tongue to the roof of your mouth. Give 4.

title: The Snowman
rules: Carrot nose, coal eyes, and a grudge from every winter you built one. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: A snowball to the face. Drink 4. 2-2: He hugs you. Drink 4. 3-3: You take his carrot. Give 3. 4-4: You take his hat. Give 4. 5-5: You turn up the thermostat. Give 4. 6-6: You build him a wife. He leaves happy. Everyone else drinks 1.

title: The Ice Sculpture
rules: A swan carved in ice, from a wedding nobody came back from. It moves. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It pecks. Drink 8. 2-8: It pecks. Drink 4. 9-19: You chip it into ice cubes. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You chip it into ice cubes. Give 8.

title: The Mammoth
rules: Thawed out of the ice cream tubs and furious about the last ten thousand years. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Trampled. Drink 8. 2-8: Trampled. Drink 4. 9-19: You show it a mammoth on your phone. It cries. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You show it a mammoth on your phone. It cries. Give 8.

title: Hypothermia Hal
rules: Hal is fine. Hal is great, actually. Hal has taken his shirt off. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Hal gives you his shirt. Drink 8. 2-8: Hal gives you his shirt. Drink 4. 9-19: You get Hal a coat. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You get Hal a coat. Give 8.

title: Margarita Elemental
rules: A slushie with salt on its rim and nothing to lose. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It brain-freezes you. Drink 8. 2-8: It brain-freezes you. Drink 4. 9-19: You lick the salt off. It's defenseless. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You lick the salt off. It's defenseless. Give 6.

title: The Shiver
rules: Say the coldest thing you've ever said to an ex, true or not. Nobody winces: drink 4.

title: Frozen Solid
rules: Strike your coldest pose and hold it, dead still, for 15 seconds. Move: drink 4.

title: The Icebreaker
rules: Deliver your best icebreaker to your left neighbor. The table groans: drink 4.

title: The Cold Open
rules: Name a cold drink for every letter of COLD in 10 seconds. Stumble: drink 4.

title: The Slippery Floor
rules: Black ice, right where the door used to be. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Flat on your back. Drink 6. 2-10: Flat on your back. Drink 3. 11-19: You triple-axel it. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You triple-axel it. Give 6.

title: The Door Shuts
rules: Click. The handle's on the outside. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You're in here now. Drink 6. 2-10: You're in here now. Drink 3. 11-19: You find the safety knob. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You find the safety knob. Give 6.

title: Icicle Drop
rules: The ceiling is all icicles, and you just sneezed. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! One finds you. Drink 6. 2-10: One finds you. Drink 3. 11-19: You step aside. It shatters. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You step aside. It shatters. Give 6.

title: Tongue on the Pole
rules: A metal shelf, a dare, and you've already done it. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Stuck. Drink 6, and talk like it for one sentence. 2-10: Stuck. Drink 3, and talk like it for one sentence. 11-19: You breathe it free. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You breathe it free. Give 6.

title: The Penguin Gang
rules: Six penguins in matching tuxes, and they say you're on their ice. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Flipper slaps, from all sides. Drink 6. 2-8: Flipper slaps, from all sides. Drink 3. 9-19: You out-waddle them. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You out-waddle them. Give 6.

title: The Frozen Peas
rules: A bag split open and now there are peas everywhere, and they're organized. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Peas down your shirt. Drink 6. 2-8: Peas down your shirt. Drink 3. 9-19: You ice your knee with them. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You ice your knee with them. Give 6.

title: Popsicle Golem
rules: A golem of a thousand stuck-together popsicles, in every flavor you hate. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Banana. Drink 8. 2-8: Banana. Drink 4. 9-19: You lick it to death. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You lick it to death. Give 8.

title: The Thawed Caveman
rules: A caveman thawed out and wants to know what a phone is. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He clubs yours. Drink 8. 2-8: He clubs yours. Drink 4. 9-19: You show him a meme and he worships you. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You show him a meme and he worships you. Give 8.
