title: Hot Sauce Ladder
rules: Each rung is a hotter sauce. Win, then cash out or climb again, harder. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Your mouth is on fire. Drink 10. 2-8: Your mouth is on fire. Drink 5. 9-19: You don't blink once. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You don't blink once. Give 8.

title: The Back Burner
rules: A pot that's been simmering since opening night. Taste it, or leave it.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Fish heads. Drink 10. 2-12: Fish heads. Drink 5. 13-19: Best soup of your life, and a draught for later. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! Best soup of your life, and a draught for later. Give 10.

title: The Mystery Meat
rules: A covered tray marked DO NOT SERVE. It's warm. Lift the lid, or don't.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It lifts the lid back. Drink 10. 2-12: It lifts the lid back. Drink 5. 13-19: Brisket. Perfect brisket. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! Brisket. Perfect brisket. Give 10.

title: The Mystery Box
rules: A chef's mystery box. Win, then cash out or open another, harder. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Durian. Drink 10. 2-8: Durian. Drink 5. 9-19: Truffles. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! Truffles. Give 8.

title: Mimic Oven
rules: An oven that bakes treats until it bites. Cash out or open it again. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It bites. Drink 10. 2-8: It bites. Drink 5. 9-19: Fresh out of the oven. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! Fresh out of the oven. Give 8.

title: The Pancake Flip
rules: The line cooks bet on your flips. Win, then cash out or flip again, harder. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It's on the ceiling. Drink 10. 2-8: It's on the ceiling. Drink 5. 9-19: Golden. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! Golden. Give 8.

title: Tap Roulette
rules: Twelve taps, unlabeled. Pour, then cash out or pour again, harder. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! That one was cleaning fluid. Drink 6. 2-6: That one was cleaning fluid. Drink 3. 7-19: Lovely. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! Lovely. Give 4.

title: The Experimental Batch
rules: A vat labeled DO NOT DRINK, BATCH 13. Pour a glass, or leave it.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It was mostly chili. Drink 8. 2-10: It was mostly chili. Drink 4. 11-19: It's incredible, and it comes with a growler. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! It's incredible, and it comes with a growler. Give 6.

title: The Locked Cold Room
rules: A cold room with a padlock and something humming inside. Break in, or don't.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Something bites on the way in. Drink 8. 2-11: Something bites on the way in. Drink 4. 12-19: Kegs, and a coaster shield. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! Kegs, and a coaster shield. Give 6.

title: Bottle Flip
rules: Bottle flips with the brewers. Win, then cash out or flip again, harder. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It smashes. Drink 6. 2-6: It smashes. Drink 3. 7-19: It lands. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! It lands. Give 4.

title: Mimic Fermenter
rules: A fermenter that burps out prizes until it bites. Win, then cash out or poke it. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It bites. Drink 6. 2-6: It bites. Drink 3. 7-19: It burps. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! It burps. Give 4.

title: Keg Toss
rules: The brewers toss empty kegs for prizes. Win, then cash out or throw again. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Keg to the foot. Drink 6. 2-6: Keg to the foot. Drink 3. 7-19: Clean toss. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! Clean toss. Give 4.

title: Ice Bucket Challenge
rules: A bucket of ice water on a rope. Pull, then cash out or pull again, harder. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! The whole bucket. Drink 8. 2-7: The whole bucket. Drink 4. 8-19: Just a splash. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! Just a splash. Give 6.

title: Frozen in the Ice
rules: A bottle frozen in a block of ice, or a hand holding one. Chip it out, or leave it.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It's a hand. Drink 8. 2-11: It's a hand. Drink 4. 12-19: A bottle of something old and good. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! A bottle of something old and good. Give 8.

title: The Chest Freezer
rules: A padlocked chest freezer, scratched on the inside of the lid. Open it, or don't.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Something climbs out. Drink 8. 2-11: Something climbs out. Drink 4. 12-19: Ice cream and a loaded die. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! Ice cream and a loaded die. Give 8.

title: Ice Fishing
rules: A hole in the ice, a line in it. Cash out or cast again, harder. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You fall in. Drink 8. 2-7: You fall in. Drink 4. 8-19: A bite. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! A bite. Give 6.

title: Mimic Fridge
rules: A mini fridge with a heartbeat. It pays out until it bites. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It bites. Drink 8. 2-7: It bites. Drink 4. 8-19: A cold one. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! A cold one. Give 6.

title: The Snow Globe
rules: Shake the giant snow globe. Win, then cash out or shake again, harder. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It cracks. Drink 8. 2-7: It cracks. Drink 4. 8-19: Something floats up. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! Something floats up. Give 6.

title: Ring Toss
rules: Ring toss over the bottles. Win, then cash out or throw again, harder. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! The ring goes off the roof. Drink 10. 2-8: The ring goes off the roof. Drink 5. 9-19: Ringer. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! Ringer. Give 8.

title: The Telescope
rules: A coin-op telescope pointed at a window across the street. Look, or don't.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! They look back. Drink 10. 2-12: They look back. Drink 5. 13-19: Someone hid a flask in the coin slot. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! Someone hid a flask in the coin slot. Give 10.

title: The Water Tower
rules: A ladder up the water tower, and something glinting at the top. Climb, or don't.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! A rung gives. Drink 10. 2-12: A rung gives. Drink 5. 13-19: A sealed bag and the best view in town. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! A sealed bag and the best view in town. Give 10.

title: Paper Planes
rules: Bet on the paper planes the regulars throw off the roof. Cash out or bet again. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Yours nosedives. Drink 10. 2-8: Yours nosedives. Drink 5. 9-19: Yours glides. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! Yours glides. Give 8.

title: Mimic Planter
rules: A planter that grows prizes until it bites. Cash out or dig again. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It bites. Drink 10. 2-8: It bites. Drink 5. 9-19: Something sprouts. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! Something sprouts. Give 8.

title: Rooftop Dares
rules: The roof plays truth or dare, and the stakes go up. Cash out or go again. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Dared. Drink 10. 2-8: Dared. Drink 5. 9-19: You dare them back. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You dare them back. Give 8.

title: Brad Knows the Owner
rules: Brad's cousin knows the owner, so the Quarter-Zips cut in. Drop a bigger name. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! His cousin really does know the owner. Drink 6. 2-7: His cousin really does know the owner. Drink 3. 8-19: The owner has never heard of Brad. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! The owner has never heard of Brad. Give 6.

title: Chad's Fake ID
rules: You and your left neighbor (Chad) do 10 seconds of Canadian each. Chad wins: drink 3.

title: We're Together
rules: Thad cuts in, telling the bouncer 'we're together'. You're not. Roll 2d6 to argue.
dice: 2d6 — 2-6: The bouncer believes him. Drink 3. 7-12: The bouncer believes you. Give 3.

title: The Group Name
rules: The Quarter-Zips have a group name, a hashtag and matching vests. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! They look cooler than you. Drink 6. 2-7: They look cooler than you. Drink 3. 8-19: You have a jacket. It beats a vest. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You have a jacket. It beats a vest. Give 6.

title: The Guest List
rules: Brad is on the list. You're on a napkin the bouncer is holding. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: The napkin blows away. Drink 3. 2-2: The bouncer blows his nose on the napkin. Drink 3. 3-3: The napkin holds up. Give 2. 4-4: You're on the list, and Brad's spelled wrong. Give 3. 5-5: You're on the list twice. Give 3. 6-6: Brad's off the list. Everyone else drinks 1.

title: The Cover Charge
rules: Chad tells the bouncer you're paying for all the Quarter-Zips. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! The bouncer believes him. Drink 6. 2-7: The bouncer believes him. Drink 3. 8-19: The bouncer charges Chad double. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! The bouncer charges Chad double. Give 6.

title: The Hand Stamp
rules: Thad licked his hand stamp onto Brad's hand, and they want to try it on you. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It works on you. Drink 6. 2-7: It works on you. Drink 3. 8-19: You wash it off in a puddle. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You wash it off in a puddle. Give 6.

title: Rock, Paper, Brad
rules: Rock, paper, scissors with your left neighbor (Brad), best of three. Lose: drink 3.

title: Chad's Shortcut
rules: Chad found a service elevator and is holding the door shut on you. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He wins. Take the stairs and drink 8. 2-9: He wins. Take the stairs and drink 4. 10-19: You squeeze in. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You squeeze in. Give 8.

title: Brad's Group Photo
rules: Brad stops the whole staircase for a group photo, and you're in the way. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-6: You're cropped out. Drink 4. 7-12: You photobomb it. Give 4.

title: Thad's Pep Talk
rules: Thad pep-talks the boys. Give your table a better one in 10 seconds. Worse: drink 4.

title: Brad's Leaderboard
rules: Brad keeps a leaderboard of who's had the most tonight, and you're second. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He pulls ahead. Drink 8. 2-9: He pulls ahead. Drink 4. 10-19: You overtake him. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You lap him twice. Everyone else drinks 3.

title: The Recruitment
rules: The Quarter-Zips want you in. Thad is holding out a quarter-zip. Roll d20 to say no.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You say yes. Drink 8. 2-9: You say yes. Drink 4. 10-19: You say no and mean it. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You say no and mean it. Give 8.

title: The Last Table
rules: The Quarter-Zips want your table. Brad is already sitting on it. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Brad sits on you. Drink 8. 2-11: Brad sits on you. Drink 4. 12-19: You tip the table, gently. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You tip Brad off it. Everyone else drinks 3.

title: A Toast to the Boys
rules: Thad is giving a toast about 'the boys', eleven minutes in. Roll d20 to cut him off.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You cry at it. Finish your drink. 2-11: It's moving, somehow. Raise a glass and drink 4. 12-19: You raise a glass mid-sentence, and it's over. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You raise a glass mid-sentence, and it's over. Give 8.

title: Chad's Last Round
rules: Chad ordered the last round, for the boys only. Intercept it. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He drinks yours in front of you. Drink 8. 2-11: He drinks yours in front of you. Drink 4. 12-19: You carry the tray to your own table. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You carry the tray, and Chad tips you. Everyone else drinks 3.

title: Brad's Venmo Request
rules: Brad has Venmo-requested everyone here $14.50 for 'vibes'. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You accidentally pay it. Drink 8. 2-11: You accidentally pay it. Drink 4. 12-19: You request $15 back for 'better vibes'. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You request $15 back for 'better vibes'. Give 8.

title: The Dance-Off
rules: The Quarter-Zips call a dance-off. The whole bar is watching. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Brad does the worm. You can't follow that. Drink 4. 2-2: You pull something. Drink 4. 3-3: Thad dips you. You let him. Drink 4. 4-4: You do the robot, and mean it. Give 4. 5-5: You moonwalk out the door and back. Give 4. 6-6: Everyone in the bar joins your dance. Everyone else drinks 2.

title: The Boys' Tab
rules: Brad closes his tab and puts it on yours. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Signed. Drink 8. 2-11: Signed. Drink 4. 12-19: You sign it 'Brad'. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You sign it 'Brad'. Give 8.

title: Thad's Uber
rules: Thad ordered one ride for everyone, and it's a Prius. Roll 2d6 for a seat.
dice: 2d6 — 2-7: You're in the trunk. Drink 4. 8-12: Front seat. Give 4.

title: The Rematch
rules: Chad wants a rematch for the queue. He's been stretching since the door. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He's been training. Drink 8. 2-11: He's been training. Drink 4. 12-19: Same result as the door. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! Chad is so impressed he buys your table a round. Everyone else drinks 3.

title: The Peephole
rules: A slot opens. Invent a password in 5 seconds and sell it. Table says no: drink 3.

title: Flapper Fran
rules: Fran challenges you to a Charleston. Do 5 seconds of it, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Two left feet. Drink 6. 2-7: Two left feet. Drink 3. 8-19: The room applauds. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! The room applauds. Give 6.

title: Bathtub Gin
rules: A bathtub full of homemade gin, and a ladle. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: It tastes like a radiator. Drink 3. 2-2: You go blind for a minute. Drink 3. 3-3: Smooth, somehow. Give 2. 4-4: You ladle out a round. Give 3. 5-5: You find the still's off switch. Give 3. 6-6: You bottle it and sell it. Everyone else drinks 1.

title: The Proprietor
rules: A bootlegger, dead since Prohibition, still running the room. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He pours you the bathtub special. Drink 8. 2-9: He pours you the bathtub special. Drink 4. 10-19: You tip off the feds. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You buy the place. Everyone else drinks 3.

title: Bottle Service
rules: A server brings a sparkler bottle and a bill for $900. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-6: You sign it. Drink 3. 7-12: It was for the next table. Give 3.

title: The Influencer
rules: Take the most flattering photo of the table in 10 seconds. They hate it: drink 3.

title: The Bodyguard
rules: Six-five, an earpiece, no neck. He wants to see your wristband. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! No wristband. Drink 6. 2-7: No wristband. Drink 3. 8-19: You walk in like you own it. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You walk in like you own it. Give 6.

title: The Promoter
rules: He's put your name on a list. You don't know which list. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You're the promoter now. Finish your drink. 2-9: The bad list. Drink 4. 10-19: You're on the good list. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You're on the good list. Give 8.

title: The Accountant
rules: He's found a discrepancy in the books, and it's you. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You're the discrepancy. Drink 6. 2-7: You're the discrepancy. Drink 3. 8-19: You find his discrepancy. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You find his discrepancy. Give 6.

title: The Security Camera
rules: Freeze like a statue for 15 seconds while the table tries to crack you. Move: drink 3.

title: The Safe
rules: The combination is somebody's birthday. Guess whose and roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: The alarm goes off. Drink 3. 2-2: A dye pack. Drink 3, blue. 3-3: Cracked it. Empty, but you look cool. Give 2. 4-4: Petty cash. Give 3. 5-5: Petty cash and a bottle. Give 3. 6-6: It was the owner's birthday. Everyone else drinks 1.

title: The Manager
rules: He needs you to come in on Saturday. He's not asking. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You're working Saturday. Drink 8. 2-9: You're working Saturday. Drink 4. 10-19: You quit, loudly. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You get his job. Everyone else drinks 3.

title: The Card Sharp
rules: He deals you in with a smile you don't like. Roll 2d6 for your hand.
dice: 2d6 — 2-6: Two pair. His is better. Drink 3. 7-12: Full house. Give 3.

title: The Tell
rules: Tell two truths and a lie. Anyone spots the lie: you drink 3.

title: The Dealer
rules: She's dealing from the bottom of the deck and smiling about it. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Busted. Drink 6. 2-7: Busted. Drink 3. 8-19: You catch her. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You catch her. Give 6.

title: Big Mike
rules: He has never lost a hand, and he plays with real money and fake teeth. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Big Mike takes the pot. Drink 8. 2-9: Big Mike takes the pot. Drink 4. 10-19: You call his bluff. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You take the pot and his teeth. Everyone else drinks 3.

title: The Arm Wrestle
rules: Arm-wrestle your right neighbor, best of one. Lose: drink 3.

title: The Ref
rules: A ref with one rule: there are no rules. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He calls it on you. Drink 6. 2-7: He calls it on you. Drink 3. 8-19: He raises your hand. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! He raises your hand. Give 6.

title: The Undercard
rules: The undercard fighter is warming up, on you. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Jab, jab, hook. Drink 3. 2-2: Headlock. Drink 3. 3-3: You slip the jab. Give 2. 4-4: You counter. Give 3. 5-5: You knock him out of the ring. Give 3. 6-6: The crowd lifts you up. Everyone else drinks 1.

title: The Undefeated
rules: He has a belt, a mouthguard and a grudge he can't remember starting. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You go through a table. Finish your drink. 2-9: Down for the count. Drink 4. 10-19: You take the belt. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You take the belt. Give 8.

title: Flooded Stairs
rules: The stairs are underwater. Every trap costs one more heart. Take a smoke bomb down.

title: Happy Hour
rules: Two for one, all the way down. Every heal heals one more heart. Everyone drinks 1.

title: Running a Tab
rules: You start two hearts short, but the bar put a shield and a draught on your tab.

title: The Lock-In
rules: Locked in until sunrise. Every boss takes one more hit. Take a loaded die and a shield.

title: Cargo Shorts
rules: You wore cargo shorts: drink 3. One more satchel slot, and a draught in a pocket.

title: Butterfingers
rules: Everyone's already a bit gone. One satchel slot fewer, but you get two more hearts.

title: Blood Moon
rules: Blood moon. Monsters, elites and ambushes cost a heart more. Start with two more hearts.

title: Lefty Night
rules: Everyone drinks with their off hand all crawl. Caught using the other: drink 1.

title: Karaoke Night
rules: Before every boss swing, the drawer sings one line of anything. Refuse: drink 2.

title: The Regulars
rules: The bartender knows you, and your tab. Everyone drinks 2. Start with two more hearts.

title: Thin Walls
rules: Everyone can hear you. Every trial costs a heart more, but every heal heals one more.

title: The Pregame
rules: Everyone drinks 1 at the door. Start a heart short, with a loaded die and a shield.

title: Payday
rules: Everyone got paid today. Gambles and relics roll 2 higher. Start a heart short.

title: Designated Driver
rules: The DD packed a draught. One more satchel slot, but bosses cost a heart more.

title: Friday the 13th
rules: Bad luck and good luck: natural 1s land on a 2 too, natural 20s on a 19.

title: Trivia Night
rules: Trivia upstairs, so everyone's sharp. Trials cost a heart less, traps a heart more.

title: Brad's Birthday
rules: Brad's birthday: the Quarter-Zips are feral. Ambushes cost a heart more. Take a shield.

title: Open Bar
rules: A wedding upstairs has an open bar. Take two draughts, but one satchel slot fewer.

title: Name Tags
rules: Everyone picks a fantasy name at the door and answers only to it. Wrong name: drink 1.

title: Lucky Penny
rules: A lucky penny on the stairs. Every d20 fight rolls 1 higher, but start two hearts short.

title: Barbarian
rules: Rage first. Questions never. +2 to boss d20s. Traps hurt 1 more.

title: Rogue
rules: Already has your wallet. +2 to trap and relic d20s. +1 satchel slot. Starts with a Smoke Bomb.

title: Cleric
rules: Blesses every drink, loudly. Every heal heals 1 more.

title: Wizard
rules: Reads the menu like a spellbook. −2 max hearts. Starts with 2 Loaded Dice.

title: Bard
rules: Brought a guitar. Nobody asked. +1 max heart. Natural 20 on a 19 or 20.

title: Paladin
rules: Sworn to guard the table's drinks. +1 max heart. Starts with a Coaster Shield.

title: Ranger
rules: Tracks the bar by smell. +2 to monster d20s. Bosses hurt 1 more.

title: Drunken Monk
rules: Starts drunk. Gets better. −1 max heart. Natural 1 on a 1 or 2.

title: Necromancer
rules: Has died twice tonight already. −3 max hearts. Starts with a Second Wind.

title: Alchemist
rules: Has a flask for every flask. +1 max heart. +1 satchel slot. Starts with 2 Healing Draughts.

title: Warlock
rules: Sold their soul for a better seat. −3 max hearts. +2 to every battle d20.

title: Bouncer
rules: Checked your ID twice. +2 max hearts. Ambushes hurt 1 less.

title: Bartender
rules: Knows everyone's order. +1 max heart. +1 satchel slot. Starts with a Bar Tab and a Healing Draught.

title: Mercenary
rules: Will fight anything for a drink. +1 to monster d20s. +3 to elite d20s.

title: Druid
rules: Smells like moss. Talks to the plants. +1 max heart. +2 to trap d20s.

title: The Plus-One
rules: Nobody knows who invited them. −3 max hearts. −1 to boss d20s. Every 20 is rerolled.

title: The Intern
rules: Unpaid. Here for the experience. −2 max hearts. Natural 1 on a 1 or 2. −2 satchel slots.

title: The Mimic
rules: A chest. Thinks it's one of you. −4 max hearts. −1 to every battle d20. +2 satchel slots.
